violation_summary.note: All violations are real, known, and classified. No hidden violations.

must_fix_before_live.classification: Auth-guard imports that prevent production build
must_fix_before_live.remediation_strategy: Remove imports; replace with ctx.verifiedSessionSnapshot pattern

must_fix_before_live_critical.classification: withAuth(), requireSession(), requireAuth() calls in route handlers
must_fix_before_live_critical.lane_based_approach: Modernize routes in controlled lanes (15 routes/week) with testing per lane

safe_to_defer.note: All violations are must-fix before live. No deferrable patterns identified.

auth_guard_imports.root_cause: Routes written before X9G modernization; importing legacy auth helpers
auth_guard_imports.remediation: Remove import; replace usage with ctx.verifiedSessionSnapshot

withAuth_calls.root_cause: Legacy auth pattern; routes directly calling withAuth() instead of using modernized governance
withAuth_calls.impact: Routes may bypass capability enforcement if pattern is inconsistent
withAuth_calls.remediation: Replace with ctx.verifiedSessionSnapshot access + capability check

requireSession_calls.root_cause: Legacy session validation before modern policy enforcement
requireSession_calls.impact: Direct session checks may bypass capability enforcement

requireAuth_calls.root_cause: Legacy auth retrieval without capability enforcement
requireAuth_calls.impact: Auth retrieved but capability may not be enforced
requireAuth_calls.remediation: Replace with ctx.verifiedSessionSnapshot + capability check via policy wrapper

AuthContext_type_imports.root_cause: Type layer still references legacy auth context type
AuthContext_type_imports.impact: Type compilation error in production build
AuthContext_type_imports.remediation: Update type imports to CanonicalAuthContext or ctx.verifiedSessionSnapshot type

scanner_operational_assessment.assessment: Scanner is OPERATIONAL and ACCURATE. It correctly identifies all shadow auth reads. It is not blind. All 444 violations are real, known, and remediable through controlled route modernization lanes.

scanner_operational_assessment.path_to_zero_violations: Complete X9G phases 5+ to modernize remaining 30+ routes → Scanner will report 0 violations → Ready for live launch

remediation_lanes.lane_based_approach: Required for controlled modernization without breaking existing functionality

lane_1_routes_1_to_15.validation: Each route passes unit tests + integration test
